name: historical_status_repair

information_policy: Prior-close signals use 16:00 Asia/Shanghai; opening execution uses 09:25. comparison: Reconcile every positive vendor session to dated notices and every eligibility removal. Compare old and new models, predictions, choices, continuous and ten-session accounts. The diagnostic preserves old ranks and common forecasts and is not a new trained strategy. Attribute the remaining change to full rebuilding and retraining.
verification: Exact untouched-parent rebuild, exact unchanged raw/actions/calendar/row identities and feature names; record all feature and label changes; no new eligible rows; exclude all 2755 reviewed warning sessions, remove exactly 1634 formerly eligible rows. Verify 48 model reloads, all new and fixed-forecast account audits, 75 complete paper accounts and original frozen-file hashes.
adoption: Retain sourced data corrections regardless of historical return impact. Activate only after the full registered training and independent account checks pass; then bind a new nonblocking status-review record to the corrected bundle. Never rewrite the old impact review or infer fresh market data or superiority from engineering validation.
limitations: Retrospective research on repeatedly inspected windows; no independent forward performance evidence.
The ten positive intervals are source-reviewed; negative vendor flags, full historical listings/delistings, industries, Beijing stocks and funds are not certified.
Calendar publication dates do not prove an exact intraday public-availability time; daily suspension flags do not certify opening status.
